entries.name: Microchipping
entries.definition: Implanting an identification microchip under an animal's skin and registering it to the owner.

entries.name: Microcontrollers
entries.definition: Small single-chip computers that combine a processor, memory and input and output pins, used to control embedded devices.

entries.name: Microscopic anatomy
entries.definition: The study of the body's structures at a scale that needs a microscope, including tissues (histology) and cells (cytology).

entries.name: Microsite
entries.definition: A small, separate website or set of pages built for a specific campaign, product or event, apart from a company's main site.

entries.name: Microsoft 365
entries.definition: Microsoft's subscription service that bundles Office applications with cloud services such as email, file storage and collaboration tools.

entries.name: Microsoft Bookings
entries.definition: A Microsoft 365 app that lets customers book appointments online and helps staff manage their schedules.

entries.name: Microsoft Bot Framework
entries.definition: Microsoft's software development kit and set of services for building, connecting and deploying conversational bots.

entries.name: Microsoft Digital Image Suite
entries.definition: Microsoft consumer software for editing, organising and sharing digital photos.

entries.name: Microsoft Forms
entries.definition: A Microsoft 365 app for creating surveys, quizzes and polls and collecting the responses.

entries.name: Microsoft HoloLens
entries.definition: A mixed-reality headset made by Microsoft that overlays holograms on the user's view of the real world.

entries.name: Microsoft Language Interface Pack
entries.definition: A downloadable Microsoft add-on that translates much of the Windows or Office interface into another language.

entries.name: Microsoft Lists
entries.definition: A Microsoft 365 app for tracking information and work in customisable lists.

entries.name: Microsoft Lync
entries.definition: Microsoft's business instant-messaging, presence and conferencing software, later renamed Skype for Business.

entries.name: Microsoft Paint
entries.definition: A basic raster graphics editor included with Windows.

entries.name: Microsoft Sentinel
entries.definition: Microsoft's cloud-native security information and event management (SIEM) and security orchestration, automation and response (SOAR) service.

entries.name: Microsoft Teams live events
entries.definition: A Microsoft Teams feature for broadcasting meetings and presentations to large online audiences.

entries.name: Microsoft Teams Phone
entries.definition: The calling features of Microsoft Teams, which let users place and receive phone calls through Teams.

entries.name: Microsoft Transaction Server
entries.definition: A Microsoft runtime from the 1990s for running and managing transactions and components in Windows server applications, later merged into COM+.

entries.name: Microsoft Visio
entries.definition: A Microsoft application for drawing diagrams such as flowcharts, floor plans and network maps.

entries.name: Microsoft Works
entries.definition: A low-cost Microsoft productivity suite that combined a word processor, spreadsheet and database.

entries.name: MicroStation
entries.definition: A computer-aided design application from Bentley Systems for 2D and 3D design and drafting, used mainly in infrastructure and architecture.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Desktop
entries.definition: The desktop application of MicroStrategy's business intelligence software, used to build reports and dashboards.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Intelligence Server
entries.definition: The server component of MicroStrategy's business intelligence software that runs queries, caches results and serves reports to users.

entries.name: MicroStrategy metrics
entries.definition: In MicroStrategy, the objects that define business calculations, such as total revenue, which reports and dashboards display.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Office
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy add-in that lets users run and analyse MicroStrategy reports inside Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

entries.name: MicroStrategy OLAP Services
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy extension that lets users slice and filter report results held in memory without re-querying the database.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Report Services
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy component for building formatted, multi-section documents and dashboards from several reports.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Software Development Kit
entries.definition: A set of programming interfaces and tools for customising and extending MicroStrategy applications.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Transaction Services
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy feature that lets users write data back to a database from reports and documents.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Visual Insight
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy interface for building interactive data visualisations and dashboards.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Web
entries.definition: The web interface of MicroStrategy's business intelligence software, used to run reports and build dashboards in a browser.

entries.name: MIKE URBAN
entries.definition: DHI software for modelling urban water systems such as sewers, stormwater drainage and water distribution.

entries.name: Military standards and specifications
entries.definition: US Department of Defense documents, such as MIL-STD and MIL-SPEC, that set technical, quality and process requirements for defence products.

entries.name: Mill test report
entries.definition: A document from a metal mill that certifies the chemical and mechanical properties of a batch of material supplied with it.

entries.name: Millimeter waves
entries.definition: Radio waves with wavelengths of about 1 to 10 millimetres (30 to 300 GHz), used in 5G, radar and imaging.

entries.name: Mind mapping
entries.definition: Organising ideas as a branching diagram that spreads out from one central concept.

entries.name: Mineralogy
entries.definition: The study of minerals, including their composition, structure, properties and occurrence.

entries.name: MITRE ATT&CK
entries.definition: A knowledge base from MITRE of the tactics and techniques that attackers use, organised for threat modelling and defence.

entries.name: Mixed reality
entries.definition: Technology that blends real and virtual objects so that they interact in real time.

entries.name: Mobile application design
entries.definition: Designing the screens, navigation and interactions of apps for phones and tablets.
